inventory_completeness.note: Every item in this registry is referenced by a mapping, so the registry was derived from the mappings rather than from the framework. It cannot contain controls this crosswalk has not mapped. Authoritative total not yet established.

changelog.change: Corrected the attribution (#189). AIUC-1 is maintained by the Artificial Intelligence Underwriting Company (the aiuc-1.com footer), not the UK AI Safety Institute, and the old URL (ai-safety-institute.org) did not resolve. The Open Government Licence was removed: AIUC-1 is not a UK Crown publication, and no licence is stated on aiuc-1.com or in the aiunderwriting/AIUC-1-Changelog repository, so the field reads "not verified" until a human confirms the terms. "version": "1.0" is kept as the mapped label, but AIUC-1 names its releases by date; see data/framework-sources.json.
changelog.author: OWASP GenAI Data Security Initiative
